rephrased_query: How do you link one note to another using wikilinks in Obsidian?
expected_answer: Type [[ followed by the note's name to create an internal link, and select the note from the suggestion list that appears.

rephrased_query: How do note properties (YAML frontmatter) work and how do you add them?
expected_answer: Properties are key-value metadata stored at the top of a note in YAML frontmatter, editable through the Properties view or directly as text.

rephrased_query: How can you add and use tags to categorize your notes?
expected_answer: Add a tag by typing # followed by a word anywhere in a note, or list tags in the tags property; click a tag to see all notes sharing it.

rephrased_query: Where do you customize keyboard shortcuts for commands in Obsidian?
expected_answer: Open Settings, then Hotkeys, to view and assign custom key combinations to any command.

rephrased_query: What is the Canvas core plugin and how do you use an infinite whiteboard for notes?
expected_answer: Canvas is a core plugin that provides an infinite space where you can arrange notes, images, and text as cards connected by lines.

rephrased_query: How do you create and insert a reusable note template?
expected_answer: Enable the Templates core plugin, create a template note, and insert it into another note with the Insert template command.

rephrased_query: How do you search for text across all notes in your vault?
expected_answer: Use the Search core plugin panel to run a full-text search across the vault, with support for operators like path:, tag:, and file:.

rephrased_query: What is callout syntax used for highlighted note boxes like tips or warnings?
expected_answer: Callouts are created with > [!type] syntax at the start of a blockquote and render as styled boxes such as note, tip, or warning.

rephrased_query: Where can you see which notes link back to the current note?
expected_answer: The Backlinks pane lists every note that links to the currently open note.

rephrased_query: How does the Daily notes core plugin work for keeping a journal?
expected_answer: The Daily notes plugin creates a new note for today's date using a configurable template and folder, opened with a single command.

rephrased_query: How do you visualize the connections between notes in your vault?
expected_answer: The Graph view core plugin displays notes as nodes and links between them as lines, showing how notes relate to each other.

rephrased_query: Is there a way to insert small reusable pieces of text, similar to templates but shorter?
expected_answer: Use the Templates plugin, or the community Templater plugin, to insert predefined text snippets into a note.

rephrased_query: How can you see a visual map of how all your notes connect?
expected_answer: The Graph view shows a visual network of your notes and the links between them, which can be filtered and styled.

rephrased_query: How do you label notes with keywords so you can filter or find them later?
expected_answer: Tags let you attach keywords to notes, which you can then use to filter search results or browse in the tag pane.

rephrased_query: How do you toggle a note between editing mode and Reading view?
expected_answer: Click the book icon in the top right of a note, or use the toggle reading view command, to switch between editing and reading mode.

rephrased_query: How does the Graph view visualize connections between notes?
expected_answer: The Graph view core plugin renders each note as a node and each link as an edge, letting you explore how notes are connected.

rephrased_query: How are tags used to organize notes within a vault?
expected_answer: Tags are added with a # prefix and let you group and filter notes by topic across the whole vault.

rephrased_query: How do you write mathematical formulas using LaTeX syntax in notes?
expected_answer: Wrap LaTeX syntax in single dollar signs for inline math or double dollar signs for a block, and Obsidian renders it using MathJax.

rephrased_query: What is the markdown syntax for creating callout blocks like warning, info, or tip?
expected_answer: Callouts use > [!type] at the start of a blockquote, where type can be note, tip, warning, info, and other supported kinds.

rephrased_query: How do you link to or embed a specific block or paragraph from another note?
expected_answer: Add a caret and an ID (^blockid) after a block to reference it, then link to it with [[note#^blockid]] or embed it with ![[note#^blockid]].

rephrased_query: What is the Bases core plugin and how does it show notes as a database table?
expected_answer: Bases is a core plugin that lets you create database-like views of your notes based on their properties, displayed as tables or cards.

rephrased_query: How do you give a note an alternate name so links can use it instead?
expected_answer: Add alternate names in the aliases property of a note, and those aliases will appear as link suggestions and match unlinked mentions.

rephrased_query: How do you embed the content of another note, image, or file inline using wikilink syntax?
expected_answer: Prefix a wikilink with an exclamation mark, like ![[note]] or ![[image.png]], to embed that file's content directly in the current note.

rephrased_query: How do you browse and install third-party community plugins?
expected_answer: Open Settings, then Community plugins, turn off restricted mode, then browse and install plugins from the community plugin store.

rephrased_query: Where do you change the visual theme and color scheme of the app?
expected_answer: Go to Settings, then Appearance, to switch between light and dark mode and choose a built-in or community theme.

rephrased_query: How do you use custom CSS to change Obsidian's appearance beyond themes?
expected_answer: Place a .css file in the snippets folder and enable it in Settings, then Appearance, under CSS snippets, to apply custom styling.

rephrased_query: How do you keep a vault synchronized across multiple devices?
expected_answer: The Obsidian Sync subscription service, or a third-party tool, keeps the same vault files up to date across all your devices.

rephrased_query: How do you turn your notes into a public website or digital garden?
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish lets you select notes and publish them as a hosted website, with its own domain and site settings.

rephrased_query: How does the Web Clipper browser extension save pages into your vault?
expected_answer: The Obsidian Web Clipper is a browser extension that captures a webpage as a note, converting it to markdown and saving it to a chosen vault and folder.

rephrased_query: How do you migrate existing notes from another app like Evernote or Notion into Obsidian?
expected_answer: The core Importer plugin can convert and import notes from apps such as Evernote, Notion, and others directly into a vault.

rephrased_query: How do you recover an earlier version of a note after unwanted changes?
expected_answer: The File Recovery core plugin periodically saves snapshots of files, which you can browse and restore from the note's context menu.

rephrased_query: How do you save your current pane arrangement and reopen it later?
expected_answer: The Workspaces core plugin lets you save the current layout of panes and tabs and load it again by name.

rephrased_query: How do you open and use the command palette to run any command?
expected_answer: Press Ctrl or Cmd+P to open the command palette, then type to search for and run any available command.

rephrased_query: How do you bookmark notes, headings, or searches for quick access later?
expected_answer: The Bookmarks core plugin lets you save notes, files, headings, blocks, or searches to a list for one-click access.

rephrased_query: How do you view and jump between headings in the current note?
expected_answer: The Outline core plugin shows a table of contents for the active note's headings, letting you click to jump to any section.

rephrased_query: How do you preview a linked note's content by hovering over its link?
expected_answer: The Page Preview core plugin shows a popup with a note's content when you hover over an internal link while holding the modifier key.

rephrased_query: How do you record audio from your microphone directly into a note?
expected_answer: The Audio Recorder core plugin adds a command to record audio and automatically embed the resulting file in the current note.

rephrased_query: How do you split a selection out into a new note, or merge notes together?
expected_answer: The Note Composer core plugin provides commands to extract a selection into a new note or merge the current note into another.

rephrased_query: How do you open and switch between multiple vaults?
expected_answer: Click the vault icon in the lower-left corner, or use the vault switcher, to open, create, or switch between vaults.

rephrased_query: Where are attached images and files stored, and how do you change the default attachment location?
expected_answer: Set the default location for new attachments in Settings, then Files and links, choosing a fixed folder or one relative to the current note.

rephrased_query: How do you collapse a heading or list so its content is hidden?
expected_answer: Click the arrow that appears next to a heading or list item to fold it and hide its nested content.

rephrased_query: How does the Zettelkasten-style unique note creator plugin generate timestamped note IDs?
expected_answer: The Unique note creator core plugin creates a new note with a unique ID, typically a timestamp, prefixed to its name, following the Zettelkasten method.

rephrased_query: How do you turn a markdown note into a slideshow presentation?
expected_answer: The Slides core plugin lets you present a note as a slideshow, splitting slides at horizontal rule separators.

rephrased_query: Where can you see the word and character count of your notes?
expected_answer: The Word count core plugin shows word and character counts in the status bar for the active note or selection.

rephrased_query: Is there a way to browse external websites inside Obsidian instead of an outside browser?
expected_answer: The Web viewer core plugin opens external links and web pages in a tab within Obsidian.

rephrased_query: How do you recover a note that was accidentally deleted?
expected_answer: Check the system trash, or the .trash folder inside the vault depending on the deletion setting, to restore an accidentally deleted note; File Recovery snapshots can also help.

rephrased_query: How do you make a link display a different text than the note's actual title?
expected_answer: Use piped link syntax [[note|display text]], or define an alias property on the note, to refer to it by another name.

rephrased_query: How do you install third-party plugins to add new functionality?
expected_answer: Enable community plugins in settings and install any plugin from the community plugin browser to extend Obsidian's functionality.

rephrased_query: Can you save separate pane layouts for different tasks and switch between them?
expected_answer: The Workspaces plugin lets you save and switch between named layouts of open panes, useful for different tasks or projects.

rephrased_query: How do you save a web article as a note using the Web Clipper?
expected_answer: Install the Obsidian Web Clipper browser extension and use it to capture the current page as a markdown note saved to your vault.

rephrased_query: How do you migrate your existing notes into an Obsidian vault?
expected_answer: Use the Importer core plugin to bring notes in from supported apps, or copy compatible files directly into the vault folder.

rephrased_query: How do you keep the same notes synchronized between your devices?
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync keeps your vault updated across devices by syncing file changes through an end-to-end encrypted subscription service.

rephrased_query: How do you insert or embed an image inside a note?
expected_answer: Drag an image into the note, paste it, or use ![[image.png]] wikilink syntax to embed it inline.

rephrased_query: How do you publish notes so they're accessible on the web?
expected_answer: Obsidian Publish lets you select notes from your vault and publish them as pages on a public website.

rephrased_query: What does the ![[filename]] embed syntax do for notes and images?
expected_answer: Prefixing a wikilink with ! embeds the target note's or image's content directly in place, instead of just linking to it.

rephrased_query: How do you use an obsidian:// link to open a specific note from outside the app?
expected_answer: Obsidian URI links, starting with obsidian://, can open a specific vault, note, or run a command from another app or the browser.

rephrased_query: How do you trigger a menu of commands by typing / while editing a note?
expected_answer: Typing / at the start of a line opens a slash command menu for quickly inserting formatting or running commands, if enabled.

rephrased_query: What is the syntax for filters and formulas when configuring a Bases view?
expected_answer: Bases views are configured with a YAML-like syntax that defines filters, formulas, and properties, saved in a .base file.

rephrased_query: How do you enable a Zettelkasten-style ID prefix for new note names?
expected_answer: The Unique note creator core plugin can prefix new note titles with a unique, typically timestamp-based, ID in the Zettelkasten style.

rephrased_query: How do you cancel an Obsidian Sync or Publish subscription?
expected_answer: You can cancel a Sync or Publish subscription from your account billing page, and it remains active until the end of the current billing period.

rephrased_query: What are Obsidian's Insider builds and how do you get early access to new versions?
expected_answer: Insider builds are early-access versions of Obsidian available to Catalyst license holders, offering new features before the public release.

rephrased_query: Is there a migration assistant for bringing notes in from another note-taking app?
expected_answer: The Importer core plugin serves as a migration tool, converting notes from supported apps such as Evernote or Notion into your vault.

rephrased_query: How do you switch between different open vaults?
expected_answer: Click the vault name or icon in the lower-left corner to open the vault switcher and choose another vault.

rephrased_query: Can you choose which settings and plugins get synced as a profile across devices?
expected_answer: Obsidian Sync lets you selectively sync app settings, themes, and plugins between devices from the Sync settings tab.

rephrased_query: Why doesn't the backlinks panel show any linked mentions for a note?
expected_answer: Make sure the Backlinks core plugin is enabled and the panel is open; it lists notes linking to the current note.

rephrased_query: How do you make a callout foldable so it can be collapsed and expanded?
expected_answer: Add a plus or minus sign after the callout type, like > [!tip]+ or > [!tip]-, to make it collapsible and set its default fold state.

rephrased_query: How do you set up a custom domain, such as through Cloudflare, for an Obsidian Publish site?
expected_answer: In Publish site settings you can add a custom domain and configure DNS records, such as a CNAME, with your domain provider.

rephrased_query: Can you sync a vault to an iPhone using iCloud instead of Obsidian Sync?
expected_answer: On iOS, a vault can be stored in the iCloud Drive folder so it syncs automatically between devices signed into the same iCloud account.

rephrased_query: Why do my phone and computer show different versions of the same vault?
expected_answer: This usually indicates the devices aren't syncing correctly or a conflict occurred; a conflict file may be created to preserve both versions.

rephrased_query: How do you diagnose what's making Obsidian slow to start up?
expected_answer: Try disabling community plugins one by one, or check the developer console and debug info under Help, to find what is slowing startup.

rephrased_query: Why did reinstalling the Android app cause all notes to disappear, and how can they be recovered?
expected_answer: Reinstalling the app may lose track of the vault's location even though files aren't deleted; reopen the same folder, or restore via Sync or a backup.

rephrased_query: Is it possible to gift an Obsidian Sync subscription to someone else?
expected_answer: Obsidian subscriptions are tied to an individual account and there is no built-in gifting option; purchase it on their behalf using their account instead.

rephrased_query: How do you increase the overall interface and text size in Obsidian?
expected_answer: Adjust the font size or zoom level setting under Settings, then Appearance, to make text larger throughout the app.

rephrased_query: How can the same paragraph appear in multiple notes without duplicating the text?
expected_answer: Give the paragraph a block ID and embed it in other notes with ![[note#^blockid]], so all copies stay in sync with the original.

rephrased_query: What happened to the old Starred notes feature?
expected_answer: The Starred core plugin was renamed and expanded into the Bookmarks core plugin, which can bookmark notes, headings, blocks, and searches.

rephrased_query: Can you embed an external webpage in a note using an iframe?
expected_answer: Notes support raw HTML, so an iframe tag can be used to embed external web content, though some sites block being framed.

rephrased_query: How do you enable Vim key bindings for editing notes?
expected_answer: Turn on Vim key bindings in Settings, then Editor, to use Vim-style modal editing in notes.

rephrased_query: Where do deleted notes go, and how do you configure the trash behavior?
expected_answer: Settings, then Files and links, lets you choose whether deleted files go to the system trash, a local .trash folder, or are permanently deleted.

rephrased_query: Does search support regular expressions?
expected_answer: Search supports regular expressions by wrapping the pattern in forward slashes, such as /pattern/, within the search query.

rephrased_query: What is the markdown syntax for adding footnotes to a note?
expected_answer: Add a footnote reference like [^1] in the text and define its content elsewhere in the note as [^1]: footnote text.

rephrased_query: Is there a discounted student price for an Obsidian Sync subscription?
expected_answer: Obsidian offers discounted pricing for students and educators through its education and non-profit discount program, applied after verification.

rephrased_query: Why don't listed hotkeys work correctly on a non-English keyboard layout?
expected_answer: Hotkeys are often shown using US keyboard symbols, so on a different layout you may need to press the physical key in that position or reassign the hotkey.

rephrased_query: What servers or domains does the desktop app connect to, for a network security review?
expected_answer: Obsidian's core app works offline and only makes network requests for optional features like Sync, Publish, or plugin updates.

rephrased_query: What happens if two people edit the same note at the same time in a shared vault?
expected_answer: Sync resolves simultaneous edits automatically where possible, but conflicting changes may create a separate conflict file preserving both versions.

rephrased_query: How do you back up a vault using a Git repository?
expected_answer: Since a vault is just a folder of plain files, you can initialize it as a Git repository and commit changes manually or with a community plugin.

rephrased_query: Can you restore a previous version of a note without paying for Sync's version history?
expected_answer: The free File Recovery core plugin keeps local snapshots you can restore from, though Sync's version history offers longer retention.

rephrased_query: Where can you see the list of links that go out from the current note?
expected_answer: The Outgoing links pane lists every note and file the current note links to.

rephrased_query: Can you add an entire folder of notes onto a Canvas at once?
expected_answer: You can drag a folder from the file explorer onto a canvas, and Obsidian will add each note inside it as a separate card.

rephrased_query: How do you insert the current date into a note at the cursor?
expected_answer: Use the Insert current date command, or a template with the date function, to insert today's date at the cursor position.

rephrased_query: How do you exclude a specific folder from Obsidian Sync?
expected_answer: In Sync settings you can add a folder to the list of excluded paths so its files are not synced to other devices.

rephrased_query: How do you restrict access to a Publish site with a password?
expected_answer: Publish site settings let you set a password so only visitors who enter it can view the published site.

rephrased_query: How do you make a rectangular, column-style text selection with the mouse?
expected_answer: Hold the appropriate modifier key, such as Alt, while dragging the mouse to make a rectangular block selection spanning multiple lines.

rephrased_query: Can the Web Clipper use a local Ollama model for its AI features?
expected_answer: The Web Clipper supports connecting to a local Ollama instance as an AI provider for features like summarizing or extracting content.

rephrased_query: Why doesn't Obsidian Sync upload hidden folders like .git?
expected_answer: Sync ignores dotfiles and hidden folders such as .git by default, since they're treated as system or hidden files rather than vault content.

rephrased_query: If you downgrade your Sync subscription tier, do you lose existing version history?
expected_answer: Downgrading a Sync plan changes the retention window going forward, and history older than the new plan's limit may no longer be accessible.

rephrased_query: How do you put a code block example inside another code block in markdown?
expected_answer: Use a longer run of backticks for the outer fence, such as four or more, so an inner code block's triple backticks are treated as plain text.

rephrased_query: Does importing from Logseq preserve the outline and indentation structure?
expected_answer: The Importer plugin's Logseq import converts pages to notes and aims to preserve the outline's nested bullet structure as markdown lists.

rephrased_query: How do you handle a URL containing spaces inside a markdown link?
expected_answer: Replace spaces in the URL with %20, or wrap the URL in angle brackets, so the markdown link parses the address correctly.

rephrased_query: How do you turn off automatic updates for the app?
expected_answer: There is no built-in toggle to disable automatic updates in general settings; updates can be managed via installation method-specific options.

rephrased_query: How do you password-protect a published site?
expected_answer: Enable a password in the Publish site's settings so visitors must enter it before viewing the site.

rephrased_query: What is the retention period for file version history in Obsidian Sync?
expected_answer: Sync keeps version history for a length of time that depends on your subscription plan, ranging from a shorter period to a full year on higher tiers.

rephrased_query: Does Obsidian offer a discount for students and non-profit organizations?
expected_answer: Obsidian provides discounted Sync and Publish pricing for verified students, educators, and non-profit organizations.

rephrased_query: Can you move a synced vault from Obsidian Sync to a different sync provider or server?
expected_answer: Since a vault is just local files, you can stop using Obsidian Sync and switch to another sync method by pointing that tool at the vault folder.

rephrased_query: What is the markdown syntax for a comment that isn't shown in reading view?
expected_answer: Text wrapped in %% %% is treated as a comment and is hidden in reading view and when the note is published, though it appears in the editor.

rephrased_query: What is the markdown syntax for highlighting text?
expected_answer: Wrapping text in double equal signs, ==like this==, highlights it with a colored background in reading view.

rephrased_query: What does the [[note#^block]] link syntax point to?
expected_answer: This syntax links to a specific block inside another note, identified by the block's ^blockid, rather than to the whole note.

rephrased_query: What does wrapping a formula in double dollar signs do?
expected_answer: Double dollar signs delimit a block-level LaTeX math expression, rendered centered on its own line instead of inline.

rephrased_query: What does a minus sign after a callout type, like [!faq]-, mean?
expected_answer: A minus sign makes the callout foldable and collapsed by default, hiding its content until clicked open.

rephrased_query: What does the {{title}} placeholder do inside a template?
expected_answer: In the core Templates plugin, {{title}} is a variable that inserts the new note's title when the template is applied.

rephrased_query: How do you write a Bases filter formula that matches notes modified in the last week?
expected_answer: Bases filter formulas can compare file properties like file.mtime against functions such as now() and duration strings to filter recently modified notes.

rephrased_query: Does Obsidian work without an internet connection?
expected_answer: Obsidian works fully offline since notes are stored as local files; only optional features like Sync or Publish require internet access.

rephrased_query: Does an Obsidian Publish site use cookies or analytics to track visitors?
expected_answer: Publish sites are designed with minimal tracking, though hosting infrastructure may set basic technical cookies for site functionality.

rephrased_query: Is Obsidian compatible with Apple's Lockdown Mode on iOS or macOS?
expected_answer: Obsidian's core functionality generally works under Lockdown Mode, though some features relying on restricted system capabilities may be limited.

rephrased_query: Is there a maximum number of people who can share the same synced vault?
expected_answer: The number of people who can share a vault through Sync depends on how many users are added under the subscription plan's limits.

rephrased_query: Can visitors to a Publish site see an interactive graph view of the notes?
expected_answer: Publish sites can include an interactive graph view showing the connections between published notes, similar to the app's Graph view.
